# Nomily AI

Nomily AI is a BYOK voice-recording companion. It connects recordings to the
ASR and LLM providers selected by the user; it does not provide a shared
transcription account or a shared recording cloud.

## Start here

- Project README: https://github.com/Nomily-Ai/nomily-app/blob/main/README.md
- Setup guide and fixed-data demo: https://geekis.com
- Community: https://discord.gg/uQFj3Rfv54

## Repository map

- This repository: public entry point, documentation, compatibility matrix,
  media, and the local ASR reference service.
- iPhone and Apple Watch source: https://github.com/Nomily-Ai/nomily-ios
- Android source: https://github.com/Nomily-Ai/nomily-android
- Local ASR reference service: https://github.com/Nomily-Ai/nomily-app/tree/main/examples/local-asr-server
- Agent contribution guide: https://github.com/Nomily-Ai/nomily-app/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Capabilities and boundaries

- Vobot V05E uses the implemented BLE recorder workflow.
- Apple Watch records through the watchOS companion and transfers to paired iPhone.
- Plaud Note Pro, soundcore Work (D3200), DingTalk A1, and TicNote use exported-audio import workflows on iPhone; this is not a claim of direct BLE pairing.
- Local faster-whisper-compatible ASR and Ollama are optional user-operated provider integrations. Nomily is not a complete self-hosted sync stack.
- API keys, recordings, transcripts, device identifiers, and private endpoint addresses must not be committed.
